newsitem.title: GERMANY: Airbus opens Frankfurt spare parts centre.
newsitem.headline: Airbus opens Frankfurt spare parts centre.

text.p: European aircraft manufacturer Airbus Industrie is now using Frankfurt Airport (FRA) as a spare parts hub centre, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
Freight forwarder A. Hardrodt GmbH has opened a 3,000 square metre distribution centre in the Tradeport customs warehouse in the new Cargo City South freight facility.
Hundreds of Airbus aircraft parts from doors to wing-tips are immediately available here to airlines in urgent need of such parts, FAG said.
Airbus also has spare parts centres in Hamburg, Washington and Singapore and is due to open a centre in Beijing later this year, it added.
The Tradeport warehouse is 50 percent owned by FAG and 50 percent by cargo handling company LUG. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
